item.title: WPG Tour: Ridhima Dilawari Opens Four-shot Lead In The Second Leg
item.description: Zion Hills Country Club: Ridhima Dilawari closed the second day with a bogey, but before that, she produced four birdies in a row, helping her to a round of 3-under 69 to go with her first round score of 70 in the Women's Professional Golf Tour (WPGT) at the Kalhaar Blues & Greens in Ahmedabad on Thursday.

item.title: Injured NZ Quick Adam Milne Ruled Out Of T20 WC; Jamieson Named Replacement
item.description: ICC T20 World Cup: Right-arm fast bowler Adam Milne has been ruled out of the ICC T20 World Cup with a torn left hamstring and will be replaced in the squad by Kyle Jamieson, New Zealand Cricket (NZC) said on Friday.

item.title: Golf: Tough Start For Indians In Windy Conditions As Italian Molinari Takes Lead In Dubai Desert Classic
item.description: Hero Dubai Desert Classic: Francesco Molinari rolled back the years with a stunning 65 to lead by two shots after a windy first round at the 2026 Hero Dubai Desert Classic. The Italian, who has not been in the winner's circle since claiming The 147th Open Championship at Carnoustie in 2018, made light work of the breezy conditions at Emirates Golf Club thanks to eight birdies and one dropped shot.

item.title: Bangladesh Pull Out of T20 World Cup After Refusing to Travel to India
item.description: Bangladesh will not participate in next month’s T20 World Cup after refusing to play matches in India, despite the ICC rejecting its request to shift games to Sri Lanka.

item.title: Europa League: Villa Edge Fenerbahce To Seal Round Of 16 Spot, Roma Earn Vital Win
item.description: UEFA Europa League: Aston Villa secured a place in the UEFA Europa League round of 16 with a game to spare after a 1-0 victory over Fenerbahce.

item.title: Injuries Force Two Changes to South Africa’s T20 World Cup Squad
item.description: South Africa made two injury-enforced changes to their T20 World Cup squad, with Tony de Zorzi and Donovan Ferreira ruled out and Ryan Rickelton and Tristan Stubbs named as replacements.

item.title: Aus Open: Sabalenka Survives Potapova Scare; Mboko Beats Tauson
item.description: Rod Laver Arenaon Friday: World No.1 Aryna Sabalenka battled her way into the fourth round of Australian Open 2026 after surviving her biggest test at Melbourne Park, overcoming Anastasia Potapova 7-6(4), 7-6(7) at Rod Laver Arenaon Friday.

item.title: Lhuan-dre Pretorius Stars as Paarl Royals Crush Joburg Super Kings by 36 Runs in SA20 Eliminator
item.description: Teenager Lhuan-dre Pretorius’s 51 and Hardus Viljoen’s 3/24 powered Paarl Royals to a 36-run victory over Joburg Super Kings, sending JSK out of the Betway SA20. Royals advance to Qualifier 2.

item.title: Aus Open: Alcaraz Rolls Into Rd-4 With Record-breaking Win In His 100th Grand Slam Match
item.description: Swiss Roger Federer: World No.1 Carlos Alcaraz earned a 6-2, 6-4, 6-1 victory against Corentin Moutet in his 100th Grand Slam match to reach the Australian Open fourth round here on Friday.

item.title: Warner Signs Extension With BBL Club Sydney Thunder
item.description: Thunder General Manager Trent Copeland: Former Australian opener David Warner has signed a one-year extension with Sydney Thunder, the Big Bash League (BBL) club said on Friday.
